user.title: Clearable Notifications
user.description: This creates a notifications hub. Afterwards, use **Add notification** on the integration page to create each notification you want to raise from automations.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Clearable Notifications is already set up. Add notifications from its integration page.

user.title: Add notification
user.description: The notification becomes a binary sensor that is on while active. Raise it with the **Activate** action and remove it with **Clear** when the condition no longer holds.

data_description.name: Used for the entity name, e.g. "Freezer too warm".
data_description.title: Optional. Supports templates.
data_description.message: Supports templates, e.g. `Freezer at {{ states('sensor.freezer_temperature') }} °C`. Variables passed to the action are available too.
data_description.icon: Optional. Defaults to an icon matching the severity.
data_description.auto_clear_after: Optional. Clears automatically this long after the last activation, useful as a heartbeat.
data_description.persistent_notification: Mirrors the notification to the sidebar bell. Dismissing it there acknowledges it.

activate.name: Activate notification
activate.description: Raises a notification, or updates it if it is already active.

severity.name: Severity
severity.description: Overrides the configured severity. Raising the severity of an acknowledged notification makes it unacknowledged again.

variables.name: Variables
variables.description: Variables available in the configured title and message templates.

clear.name: Clear notification
clear.description: Clears a notification because its condition is no longer met.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge notification
acknowledge.description: Marks an active notification as seen. It stays active until it is cleared.

set_active.name: Set notification active
set_active.description: Activates the notification when Active is true and clears it when false. Use a template to drive it from a condition.

active.name: Active
active.description: Whether the notification should be active.
